newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Kumho to buy Miwon Petrochem stake.
newsitem.headline: Korea Kumho to buy Miwon Petrochem stake.

text.p: Korea Kumho Petrochemical Co said on Monday it has agreed to buy the biggest single stake of 25.1 percent in Miwon Petrochemical Co.
A Korea Kumho statement said it agreed to buy 1.82 million Miwon shares at 25,880 won each over the counter.
Miwon Petrochemical shares were trading at 8,640 won in Monday's afternoon session.
Five of the Kumho Group's affiliates, including Korea Kumho, are involved in the petrochemical industry.

"The purchase is expected to maximise synergy in the group when we secure raw materials, besides improving manufacturing technology and manpower and widening sales markets," a Korea Kumho official said.
